admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian General Secondary Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; minimum 60% average for Jordanians, 50% for international students; comprehensive exam GPA not less than 68% for most majors, 70% for Pharmacy and Engineering; scientific stream required for Pharmacy.
admission_requirements.exam_details: No entrance exam; admission based on Tawjihi grades and comprehensive exam GPA for diploma holders.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: Undergraduate: University English Placement Test (EPT) administered by the Language Center; no external TOEFL/IELTS required for admission. Graduate: TOEFL, IELTS, or equivalent language proficiency exam required.

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: Approximately 900-2,850 JOD/year for international bachelor's students (per studyabroadaide); local students pay per credit hour (50-85 JOD depending on program). Fee brochure 2025-2026 available on university website.
tuition_fees.engineering_majors_fees: Approximately 85 JOD per credit hour (Renewable Energy Engineering per youapply.com).
tuition_fees.humanities_majors_fees: Approximately 30-50 JOD per credit hour for humanities/business programs (per youapply.com).
tuition_fees.notes: Tuition charged per credit hour. Registration fee 120 JOD per semester (undergraduate). Refundable deposit 100 JOD. Evening students receive 20% discount on credit hour fees. Graduate studies: 75-120 JOD per credit hour after discount, registration fee 30 JOD per semester, enrollment fee 50 JOD (one-time), refundable insurance deposit 5 JOD, UID card 435 JOD (one-time). Comprehensive exam/thesis fee 200 JOD.

ranking_accreditation.national_ranking: #1 among Jordanian private universities and #4 among all Jordanian universities according to UniRank 2025; #11 in Jordan per Arab Ranking for Universities (ARU) 2025
ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), ISO 9001
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS Arab Region Rankings #127 (2026); UniRank Arab World #47; THE World University Rankings (listed); Webometrics ranked #1 among Jordanian universities (2022)

market_demand.notes: University operates a Career Guidance and Graduate Follow-up Office and Department of Alumni Affairs. In 2025, university added new programs: Supply Chain and Digital Logistics Management, Applied Chemistry, and Master of Chinese Language, designed to meet labor market needs. Exact employment rate and market demand data not publicly available.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus student dormitories found on the official website. University provides free transportation services for students.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Academic excellence scholarships for high-achieving students based on Tawjihi GPA (up to 75% for artistic, musical, and sports excellence); scholarships for children of military/security personnel and UNRWA employees (10-25%); scholarships for villagers near the campus; 20% tuition fee remission for teachers' union members enrolling in master's programs; partial financial assistance through lab supervision or research assistance; financial aid and fees payment facilities available.
